title: How Ramp engineers accelerate code review with Codex
summary: How Ramp engineers use Codex with GPT-5.5 to review code and ship improvements, allowing them to get substantive feedback in minutes instead of hours.
body: How Ramp engineers use Codex with GPT-5.5 to review code and ship improvements, allowing them to get substantive feedback in minutes instead of hours.
summaryZh: 支付与财务自动化公司Ramp的工程师们正在将集成GPT-5.5的Codex工具深度应用于代码评审流程，将原本需要数小时的反馈周期缩短至几分钟，从而显著提升了工程团队的代码交付效率。原始信息显示：How Ramp engineers use Codex with GPT-5.5 to review code and ship improvements, allowing them to get substantive feedback in minutes instead of hours.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“How Ramp engineers accelerate code review with Codex”。其重要性主要体现在：Ramp工程团队通过结合GPT-5.5的Codex工具大幅加速了代码评审和交付流程。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
